video_title: Perk Says the Knicks Can’t Ask KAT to Take Jalen Duren Money

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the necessity of player sacrifices for winning
quotes.excerpt: players are expected to make sacrifices to maintain the winning. It's really the only thing in professional business
quotes.quote: I do believe that a player, if they win a championship, the goal is winning. And then players are expected to make sacrifices to maintain the winning. It's really the only thing in professional business where you're asked to take less in order to preserve the win for the owner. You're like, hey, if you want to win, you can be here. But Karl-Anthony Towns has won, especially the last few years, conference finals with Minnesota. So the winning, I don't want to give him all the credit, but I want to give him a big piece of the pie. If winning follows you, if you can go from one place and win to the next place and win, there's a value.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Karl-Anthony Towns' impact as a play-through player
quotes.excerpt: Karl-Anthony Towns exposed the defensive player of the year on the biggest stage.
quotes.quote: All Karl-Anthony Towns, we all agree, is a play-through guy. You can play through him. He's proven. Karl-Anthony Towns exposed the defensive player of the year on the biggest stage. Go back and watch Game 1 in the NBA Finals and go look at the adjustments that Mitch Johnson had to make. He had to basically take his defensive player of the year off of Karl-Anthony Towns and hide him elsewhere.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on why players should prioritize money in their contracts
quotes.excerpt: First priority always been that for me, even when I was a vet, young guys coming into the league, first thing first, get your money.
quotes.quote: First priority always been that for me, even when I was a vet, young guys coming into the league, first thing first, get your money. This is a job. Get your money. Even in whatever field we're in, if we're doing our job at the highest level, none of us in here are going to sit up here and say, man, ESPN come to me and say, hey Perk, we want to give you a contract extension, but we need you to take less so we can be able to sign X, Y, Z. Fuck no. That's not, that don't even sound right. So why are we asking him to do it? Why, why is it even a conversation?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns' value
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is the best player, obviously. Karl-Anthony Towns is the most important player.
quotes.quote: If I'm Karl-Anthony Towns, your resume speaks for itself. You're a walking 20 and 12 guy minimum. You're arguably the best shooting big to ever touch the, one of the most skilled players to ever touch the damn basketball. Jalen Brunson is the best player, obviously. Karl-Anthony Towns is the most important player.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the unfairness of asking Karl-Anthony Towns to take less money
quotes.excerpt: You can't pay Jalen Brunson 200 million and ask Karl-Anthony Towns to take the same 200 million.
quotes.quote: You can't pay Jalen Brunson 200 million and ask Karl-Anthony Towns to take the same 200 million.
